name: animegarden
description: Search anime torrent resources aggregated from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组, ANi with Anime Garden. Provides rich filters (fansub groups, resource types, keywords, include/exclude, publish time, bangumi subjects).

search_resources.name: search_resources
search_resources.title: Search anime torrent resources aggregated from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组, ANi with Anime Garden
search_resources.description: Search anime resources with flexible filters. Supports AND-combination across different filter groups, and OR-combination within the same group (e.g. fansubs, publishers, types, subjects, include, exclude). The search option performs tokenized search and takes precedence over include; keywords requires the title to contain ALL values; exclude blocks resources containing ANY value.

fansubs.description: Fansub group names. Match ANY value (OR).

publishers.description: Publisher names. Match ANY value (OR). Combined with fansubs in OR logic within this group.

before.description: Upper time bound (inclusive): createdAt <= before. Accepts date string or timestamp.

after.description: Lower time bound (inclusive): createdAt >= after. Accepts date string or timestamp.

subjects.description: Bangumi subject IDs. Match ANY value (OR).

search.description: Full-text query terms (tokenized search). Takes precedence over include.

include.description: Title-contains terms. Match ANY value (OR). Only effective when search is not provided.

keywords.description: Required title keywords. Title must contain ALL values (AND).

exclude.description: Blocked title keywords. Exclude resources containing ANY value.
